column4: Cheap, starter tower. Has an average fire rate and low damage.
Quicker reload halfs the tower's reload speed.
Trigger action grip allows the tower to fire faster.
An extended magazine allows the tower to fire longer without reload.
Allows this tower to spot enemies from further away.
Allows this tower to fire 2 pistols at once, doubling it's fire rate and mag size, but increasing reload speed.
